samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag output, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- Parameter definitions for ALU operations -->
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD" value="6'b100000"></parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU" value="6'b100001"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB" value="6'b100010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU" value="6'b100011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="AND" value="6'b100100"></parameter>
        <parameter id="OR" value="6'b100101"></parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR" value="6'b100110"></parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR" value="6'b100111"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT" value="6'b101010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU" value="6'b101011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL" value="6'b000000"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL" value="6'b000010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA" value="6'b000011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV" value="6'b000100"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV" value="6'b000110"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV" value="6'b000111"></parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI" value="6'b001111"></parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <!-- Internal logic and outputs -->
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="res[31:0]" expression="r"></assign>
        <assign id="flag" expression="(aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU ? 1'b1 : 1'bz)"></assign>
        <assign id="zero" expression="(r == 32'h00000000 ? 1'b1 : 1'b0)"></assign>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Signed wires for inputs a and b
        wire signed [31:0] a_signed;
        wire signed [31:0] b_signed;
        
        // Register to hold result
        reg [32:0] res;
        // Assigning input operands to signed wires
        assign a_signed = a;
        assign b_signed = b;
        
        // Always block for combinational logic
        always @(aluc, a, b) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res = a_signed + b_signed;
                ADDU: res = a + b;
                SUB: res = a_signed - b_signed;
                SUBU: res = a - b;
                AND: res = a & b;
                OR: res = a | b;
                XOR: res = a ^ b;
                NOR: res = ~(a | b);
                SLT: res = {31'd0, (a_signed < b_signed)};
                SLTU: res = {31'd0, (a < b)};
                SLL: res = b << a;
                SRL: res = b >> a;
                SRA: res = b_signed >>> a;
                SLLV: res = b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res = b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res = b_signed >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res = {a[15:0], 16'd0};
                default: res = 32'hz;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Assigning result to output port r
        assign r = res[31:0];
    </implementation>
</module>
